official_definition: Shining Heaven Unleash: 1 [LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks) Destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit. Or, by putting one core from a "Grandwalker Amaterasu" you control to this Spirit, during this battle, effects of opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't activate, and return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Shining Heaven Unleash] or [Shining Heaven Unleash: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Shining Heaven Unleash]", "give [Shining Heaven Unleash]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
